        "fullName": "David LabOp",
        "email": "david@example.com",
        "roles": ["laboratory_intake_operator"],
        "assignedLocationId": lab_node["id"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(lab_req.status_code == 200, "Created lab operator user", lab_req)
    operator_user_id = lab_req.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # Requester
    req_user_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": "requester_eve",
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Eve Requester",
        "email": "eve@example.com",
        "roles": ["requester"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(req_user_res.status_code == 200, "Created requester user", req_user_res)
    requester_user_id = req_user_res.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # Dispatcher
    disp_user_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": "dispatcher_frank",
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Frank Dispatcher",
        "email": "frank@example.com",
        "roles": ["dispatcher"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(disp_user_res.status_code == 200, "Created dispatcher user", disp_user_res)
    dispatcher_user_id = disp_user_res.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # 5. Serviceability check (dry run)
    now_ts = int(time.time())
    now_iso = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now_ts))
    deadline_iso = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now_ts + 18000))
    earliest_iso = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now_ts + 600))
    latest_iso = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now_ts + 3600))

    dry_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/check-serviceability", headers=headers, json={
        "origin": {
            "latitude": 12.9784,
            "longitude": 77.6408,
            "address": "100 Feet Rd, Indiranagar"
        },
        "originType": "home",
        "sampleTypeId": st_amber["id"],
        "requestedAt": now_iso,
        "earliestCollectionAt": earliest_iso,
        "latestCollectionAt": latest_iso,
        "deliveryDeadline": deadline_iso
    })
    check(dry_res.status_code == 200, "Serviceability check near Indiranagar", dry_res)
    dry_data = dry_res.json()["data"]
    check(dry_data.get("serviceable") is True, "Indiranagar is serviceable")
    check("snapshotVersion" in dry_data, "Serviceability includes snapshotVersion")

    # Unserviceable location (> 5km from any node)
    far_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/check-serviceability", headers=headers, json={
        "origin": {
            "latitude": 13.5000,
            "longitude": 78.5000,
            "address": "Far Remote Location"
        },
        "originType": "home",
        "sampleTypeId": st_amber["id"],
        "requestedAt": now_iso,
        "earliestCollectionAt": earliest_iso,
        "latestCollectionAt": latest_iso,
        "deliveryDeadline": deadline_iso
    })
    check(far_res.status_code == 200, "Serviceability check far away", far_res)
    check(far_res.json()["data"].get("serviceable") is False, "Far location is NOT serviceable")

    # 6. Requester logs in and creates collection request
    req_auth = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": "requester_eve",
        "password": "password123"
    })
    check(req_auth.status_code == 200, "Requester authenticated", req_auth)
    req_token = req_auth.json()["data"]["sessionToken"]
    req_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {req_token}"}

    create_req = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-collection-request", headers=req_headers, json={
        "requesterId": requester_user_id,
        "origin": {
            "latitude": 12.9784,
            "longitude": 77.6408,
            "address": "100 Feet Rd, Indiranagar"
        },
        "originType": "home",
        "requestedAt": now_iso,
        "earliestCollectionAt": earliest_iso,
        "latestCollectionAt": latest_iso,
        "deliveryDeadline": deadline_iso,
        "sampleTypeId": st_amber["id"],
        "containerType": st_amber["containerType"],
        "temperatureMinC": st_amber["temperatureMinC"],
        "temperatureMaxC": st_amber["temperatureMaxC"],
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(create_req.status_code == 200, "Collection request created", create_req)
    req_resp = create_req.json()["data"]
    sample_id = req_resp.get("sampleId")
    journey_id = req_resp.get("journeyId")
    check(sample_id is not None and journey_id is not None, "Sample ID and Journey ID created")

    # Requester lists role work
    req_work = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/list-role-work", headers=req_headers, json={
        "role": "requester"
    })
    check(req_work.status_code == 200, "Requester list role work", req_work)
    req_items = req_work.json()["data"].get("workItems", [])
    check(any(item.get("sampleId") == sample_id for item in req_items), "Requester sees created request in role work")

    # 7. Collector logs in, views offered work, and accepts
    col_auth = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": "collector_alice",
        "password": "password123"
    })
    check(col_auth.status_code == 200, "Collector authenticated", col_auth)
    col_token = col_auth.json()["data"]["sessionToken"]
    col_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {col_token}"}

    col_work = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/list-role-work", headers=col_headers, json={
        "role": "certified_collection_professional"
    })
    check(col_work.status_code == 200, "Collector list role work", col_work)
    col_items = col_work.json()["data"].get("workItems", [])
    check(len(col_items) > 0, "Collector has offered work items")
    col_assignment = col_items[0]
    col_assignment_id = col_assignment["assignmentId"]

    # Collector accepts assignment
    acc_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/accept-assignment", headers=col_headers, json={
        "assignmentId": col_assignment_id,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(acc_res.status_code == 200, "Collector accepted assignment", acc_res)

    # Collector records location update
    loc_upd = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/record-worker-location", headers=col_headers, json={
        "assignmentId": col_assignment_id,
        "coordinate": {"latitude": 12.9780, "longitude": 77.6400},
        "sequence": 1,
        "recordedAt": now_iso
    })
    check(loc_upd.status_code == 200, "Collector recorded location", loc_upd)

    # Collector collects and seals sample
    seal_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/collect-and-seal-sample", headers=col_headers, json={
        "sampleId": sample_id,
        "assignmentId": col_assignment_id,
        "collectedAt": now_iso,
        "containerType": st_amber["containerType"],
        "observedTemperatureC": 22.0,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(seal_res.status_code == 200, "Sample collected and sealed", seal_res)

    # Collector records handling checkpoint
    chk_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/record-handling-checkpoint", headers=col_headers, json={
        "sampleId": sample_id,
        "assignmentId": col_assignment_id,
        "containerType": st_amber["containerType"],
        "observedTemperatureC": 21.5,
        "recordedAt": now_iso,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(chk_res.status_code == 200, "Handling checkpoint recorded", chk_res)

    # 8. Handoff to Courier
    # Courier logs in
    cou_auth = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": "courier_bob",
        "password": "password123"
    })
    check(cou_auth.status_code == 200, "Courier authenticated", cou_auth)
    cou_token = cou_auth.json()["data"]["sessionToken"]
    cou_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {cou_token}"}

    cou_work = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/list-role-work", headers=cou_headers, json={
        "role": "relay_courier"
    })
    check(cou_work.status_code == 200, "Courier list role work", cou_work)
    cou_items = cou_work.json()["data"].get("workItems", [])
    check(len(cou_items) > 0, "Courier has work items")
    cou_assignment = cou_items[0]
    cou_assignment_id = cou_assignment["assignmentId"]

    # Courier accepts assignment
    session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/accept-assignment", headers=cou_headers, json={
        "assignmentId": cou_assignment_id,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })

    # Collector initiates handoff
    init_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/initiate-handoff", headers=col_headers, json={
        "sampleId": sample_id,
        "fromAssignmentId": col_assignment_id,
        "toAssignmentId": cou_assignment_id,
        "receiverId": courier_user_id,
        "initiatedAt": now_iso,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(init_res.status_code == 200, "Collector initiated handoff", init_res)
    handoff_id = init_res.json()["data"]["handoffId"]

    # Courier confirms handoff (receiver side)
    conf_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/confirm-handoff", headers=cou_headers, json={
        "handoffId": handoff_id,
        "confirmationSide": "receiver",
        "confirmedAt": now_iso,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(conf_res.status_code == 200, "Courier confirmed handoff (receiver)", conf_res)

    # Check sample state - holder should now be courier
    sample_state = session.get(f"{BASE_URL}/read-sample-state/{sample_id}", headers=headers)
    check(sample_state.status_code == 200, "Read sample state", sample_state)
    sample_data = sample_state.json()["data"]
    check(sample_data.get("currentHolderId") == courier_user_id, "Courier is now the current holder")

    # 9. Lab Operator confirms receipt
    lab_auth = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": "operator_david",
        "password": "password123"
    })
    check(lab_auth.status_code == 200, "Lab operator authenticated", lab_auth)
    lab_token = lab_auth.json()["data"]["sessionToken"]
    lab_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {lab_token}"}

    recv_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/confirm-laboratory-receipt", headers=lab_headers, json={
        "sampleId": sample_id,
        "laboratoryId": lab_node["id"],
        "receivedAt": now_iso,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(recv_res.status_code == 200, "Lab operator confirmed receipt", recv_res)

    # Check sample lifecycle
    life_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/read-sample-lifecycle", headers=headers, json={
        "sampleId": sample_id
    })
    check(life_res.status_code == 200, "Read sample lifecycle", life_res)
    events = life_res.json()["data"].get("events", [])
    check(len(events) >= 3, "Lifecycle contains multiple status events")

    # 10. Ingest presealed sample at node
    nh_auth = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": "handler_charlie",
        "password": "password123"
    })
    check(nh_auth.status_code == 200, "Node handler authenticated", nh_auth)
    nh_token = nh_auth.json()["data"]["sessionToken"]
    nh_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {nh_token}"}

    pre_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/ingest-presealed-sample", headers=nh_headers, json={
        "origin": {
            "latitude": hub_node["coordinate"]["latitude"],
            "longitude": hub_node["coordinate"]["longitude"],
            "address": "Central Bangalore Hub"
        },
        "originType": "node",
        "originNodeId": hub_node["id"],
        "sampleTypeId": st_frost["id"],
        "containerType": st_frost["containerType"],
        "temperatureMinC": st_frost["temperatureMinC"],
        "temperatureMaxC": st_frost["temperatureMaxC"],
        "requestedAt": now_iso,
        "deliveryDeadline": deadline_iso,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(pre_res.status_code == 200, "Ingested presealed Frost sample", pre_res)
    pre_sample_id = pre_res.json()["data"]["sampleId"]
    pre_journey_id = pre_res.json()["data"]["journeyId"]

    # 11. Search audit trail
    audit_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/search-audit-trail", headers=headers, json={
        "entityId": sample_id,
        "limit": 50
    })
    check(audit_res.status_code == 200, "Search audit trail", audit_res)
    audit_entries = audit_res.json()["data"].get("entries", [])
    check(len(audit_entries) >= 3, "Audit entries present for sample")

    # 12. Read operations state
    ops_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/read-operations-state", headers=headers, json={})
    check(ops_res.status_code == 200, "Read operations state", ops_res)
    ops_data = ops_res.json()["data"]
    check("samples" in ops_data and "workers" in ops_data and "locations" in ops_data, "Operations state structure valid")

    print("\n========================================================")
    print("ALL API ENDPOINTS & WORKFLOWS VALIDATED AND PASSED 100%!")
    print("========================================================\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    check("user" in boot_data and "operations" in boot_data, "UI bootstrap data structure valid")

    ops_data = boot_data["operations"]
    locations = ops_data.get("locations", [])
    loc_map = {loc["name"]: loc for loc in locations}
    check("Indiranagar Collection Centre" in loc_map, "Indiranagar CC found")
    check("Bangalore Central Hub & Laboratory" in loc_map, "Central Bangalore Hub found")
    check("Whitefield Regional Lab" in loc_map, "Whitefield Laboratory found")

    st_amber_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111101"
    st_frost_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111103"
    hub_node = loc_map["Bangalore Central Hub & Laboratory"]
    lab_node = loc_map["Whitefield Regional Lab"]
    cc_node = loc_map["Indiranagar Collection Centre"]

    # 4. Create users with different roles
    # Collector
    col_req = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": "collector_alice",
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Alice Collector",
        "email": "alice@example.com",
        "roles": ["certified_collection_professional"],
        "certifications": ["Amber", "Indigo", "Frost", "Pulse"],
        "qualifications": ["Amber", "Indigo", "Frost", "Pulse"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(col_req.status_code == 200, "Created collector user", col_req)
    collector_user_id = col_req.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # Courier
    cou_req = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": "courier_bob",
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Bob Courier",
        "email": "bob@example.com",
        "roles": ["relay_courier"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(cou_req.status_code == 200, "Created courier user", cou_req)
    courier_user_id = cou_req.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # Node Handler
    nh_req = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": "handler_charlie",
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Charlie Handler",
        "email": "charlie@example.com",
        "roles": ["node_handler"],
        "assignedLocationId": hub_node["id"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(nh_req.status_code == 200, "Created node handler user", nh_req)
    handler_user_id = nh_req.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # Lab Operator
    lab_req = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": "operator_david",
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "David LabOp",
        "email": "david@example.com",
        "roles": ["laboratory_intake_operator"],
        "assignedLocationId": lab_node["id"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(lab_req.status_code == 200, "Created lab operator user", lab_req)
    operator_user_id = lab_req.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # Requester
    req_user_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": "requester_eve",
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Eve Requester",
        "email": "eve@example.com",
        "roles": ["requester"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(req_user_res.status_code == 200, "Created requester user", req_user_res)
    requester_user_id = req_user_res.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # Dispatcher
    disp_user_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": "dispatcher_frank",
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Frank Dispatcher",
        "email": "frank@example.com",
        "roles": ["dispatcher"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(disp_user_res.status_code == 200, "Created dispatcher user", disp_user_res)
    dispatcher_user_id = disp_user_res.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # 5. Serviceability check (dry run)
    now_ts = int(time.time())
    now_iso = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now_ts))
    deadline_iso = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now_ts + 18000))
    earliest_iso = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now_ts + 600))
    latest_iso = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now_ts + 3600))

    dry_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/check-serviceability", headers=headers, json={
        "origin": {
            "latitude": 12.9784,
            "longitude": 77.6408,
            "address": "100 Feet Rd, Indiranagar"
        },
        "originType": "home",
        "sampleTypeId": st_amber_id,
        "requestedAt": now_iso,
        "earliestCollectionAt": earliest_iso,
        "latestCollectionAt": latest_iso,
        "deliveryDeadline": deadline_iso
    })
    check(dry_res.status_code == 200, "Serviceability check near Indiranagar", dry_res)
    dry_data = dry_res.json()["data"]
    check(dry_data.get("serviceable") is True, "Indiranagar is serviceable")
    check("snapshotVersion" in dry_data, "Serviceability includes snapshotVersion")

    # Unserviceable location (> 5km from any node)
    far_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/check-serviceability", headers=headers, json={
        "origin": {
            "latitude": 13.5000,
            "longitude": 78.5000,
            "address": "Far Remote Location"
        },
        "originType": "home",
        "sampleTypeId": st_amber_id,
        "requestedAt": now_iso,
        "earliestCollectionAt": earliest_iso,
        "latestCollectionAt": latest_iso,
        "deliveryDeadline": deadline_iso
    })
    check(far_res.status_code == 200, "Serviceability check far away", far_res)
    check(far_res.json()["data"].get("serviceable") is False, "Far location is NOT serviceable")

    # 6. Requester logs in and creates collection request
    req_auth = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": "requester_eve",
        "password": "password123"
    })
    check(req_auth.status_code == 200, "Requester authenticated", req_auth)
    req_token = req_auth.json()["data"]["sessionToken"]
    req_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {req_token}"}

    create_req = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-collection-request", headers=req_headers, json={
        "requesterId": requester_user_id,
        "origin": {
            "latitude": 12.9784,
            "longitude": 77.6408,
            "address": "100 Feet Rd, Indiranagar"
        },
        "originType": "home",
        "requestedAt": now_iso,
        "earliestCollectionAt": earliest_iso,
        "latestCollectionAt": latest_iso,
        "deliveryDeadline": deadline_iso,
        "sampleTypeId": st_amber_id,
        "containerType": "standard_ambient",
        "temperatureMinC": 15.0,
        "temperatureMaxC": 25.0,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(create_req.status_code == 200, "Collection request created", create_req)
    req_resp = create_req.json()["data"]
    sample_id = req_resp.get("sampleId")
    journey_id = req_resp.get("journeyId")
    check(sample_id is not None and journey_id is not None, "Sample ID and Journey ID created")

    # Requester lists role work
    req_work = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/list-role-work", headers=req_headers, json={
        "role": "requester"
    })
    check(req_work.status_code == 200, "Requester list role work", req_work)
    req_items = req_work.json()["data"].get("workItems", [])
    check(any(item.get("sampleId") == sample_id for item in req_items), "Requester sees created request in role work")

    # 7. Collector logs in, views offered work, and accepts
    col_auth = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": "collector_alice",
        "password": "password123"
    })
    check(col_auth.status_code == 200, "Collector authenticated", col_auth)
    col_token = col_auth.json()["data"]["sessionToken"]
    col_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {col_token}"}

    col_work = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/list-role-work", headers=col_headers, json={
        "role": "certified_collection_professional"
    })
    check(col_work.status_code == 200, "Collector list role work", col_work)
    col_items = col_work.json()["data"].get("workItems", [])
    check(len(col_items) > 0, "Collector has offered work items")
    col_assignment = col_items[0]
    col_assignment_id = col_assignment["assignmentId"]

    # Collector accepts assignment
    acc_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/accept-assignment", headers=col_headers, json={
        "assignmentId": col_assignment_id,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(acc_res.status_code == 200, "Collector accepted assignment", acc_res)

    # Collector records location update
    loc_upd = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/record-worker-location", headers=col_headers, json={
        "assignmentId": col_assignment_id,
        "coordinate": {"latitude": 12.9780, "longitude": 77.6400},
        "sequence": 1,
        "recordedAt": now_iso
    })
    check(loc_upd.status_code == 200, "Collector recorded location", loc_upd)

    # Collector collects and seals sample
    seal_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/collect-and-seal-sample", headers=col_headers, json={
        "sampleId": sample_id,
        "assignmentId": col_assignment_id,
        "collectedAt": now_iso,
        "containerType": st_amber["containerType"],
        "observedTemperatureC": 22.0,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(seal_res.status_code == 200, "Sample collected and sealed", seal_res)

    # Collector records handling checkpoint
    chk_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/record-handling-checkpoint", headers=col_headers, json={
        "sampleId": sample_id,
        "assignmentId": col_assignment_id,
        "containerType": st_amber["containerType"],
        "observedTemperatureC": 21.5,
        "recordedAt": now_iso,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(chk_res.status_code == 200, "Handling checkpoint recorded", chk_res)

    # 8. Handoff to Courier
    # Courier logs in
    cou_auth = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": "courier_bob",
        "password": "password123"
    })
    check(cou_auth.status_code == 200, "Courier authenticated", cou_auth)
    cou_token = cou_auth.json()["data"]["sessionToken"]
    cou_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {cou_token}"}

    cou_work = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/list-role-work", headers=cou_headers, json={
        "role": "relay_courier"
    })
    check(cou_work.status_code == 200, "Courier list role work", cou_work)
    cou_items = cou_work.json()["data"].get("workItems", [])
    check(len(cou_items) > 0, "Courier has work items")
    cou_assignment = cou_items[0]
    cou_assignment_id = cou_assignment["assignmentId"]

    # Courier accepts assignment
    session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/accept-assignment", headers=cou_headers, json={
        "assignmentId": cou_assignment_id,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })

    # Collector initiates handoff
    init_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/initiate-handoff", headers=col_headers, json={
        "sampleId": sample_id,
        "fromAssignmentId": col_assignment_id,
        "toAssignmentId": cou_assignment_id,
        "receiverId": courier_user_id,
        "initiatedAt": now_iso,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(init_res.status_code == 200, "Collector initiated handoff", init_res)
    handoff_id = init_res.json()["data"]["handoffId"]

    # Courier confirms handoff (receiver side)
    conf_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/confirm-handoff", headers=cou_headers, json={
        "handoffId": handoff_id,
        "confirmationSide": "receiver",
        "confirmedAt": now_iso,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(conf_res.status_code == 200, "Courier confirmed handoff (receiver)", conf_res)

    # Check sample state - holder should now be courier
    sample_state = session.get(f"{BASE_URL}/read-sample-state/{sample_id}", headers=headers)
    check(sample_state.status_code == 200, "Read sample state", sample_state)
    sample_data = sample_state.json()["data"]
    check(sample_data.get("currentHolderId") == courier_user_id, "Courier is now the current holder")

    # 9. Lab Operator confirms receipt
    lab_auth = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": "operator_david",
        "password": "password123"
    })
    check(lab_auth.status_code == 200, "Lab operator authenticated", lab_auth)
    lab_token = lab_auth.json()["data"]["sessionToken"]
    lab_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {lab_token}"}

    recv_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/confirm-laboratory-receipt", headers=lab_headers, json={
        "sampleId": sample_id,
        "laboratoryId": lab_node["id"],
        "receivedAt": now_iso,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(recv_res.status_code == 200, "Lab operator confirmed receipt", recv_res)

    # Check sample lifecycle
    life_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/read-sample-lifecycle", headers=headers, json={
        "sampleId": sample_id
    })
    check(life_res.status_code == 200, "Read sample lifecycle", life_res)
    events = life_res.json()["data"].get("events", [])
    check(len(events) >= 3, "Lifecycle contains multiple status events")

    # 10. Ingest presealed sample at node
    nh_auth = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": "handler_charlie",
        "password": "password123"
    })
    check(nh_auth.status_code == 200, "Node handler authenticated", nh_auth)
    nh_token = nh_auth.json()["data"]["sessionToken"]
    nh_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {nh_token}"}

    pre_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/ingest-presealed-sample", headers=nh_headers, json={
        "origin": {
            "latitude": hub_node["coordinate"]["latitude"],
            "longitude": hub_node["coordinate"]["longitude"],
            "address": "Central Bangalore Hub"
        },
        "originType": "node",
        "originNodeId": hub_node["id"],
        "sampleTypeId": st_frost["id"],
        "containerType": st_frost["containerType"],
        "temperatureMinC": st_frost["temperatureMinC"],
        "temperatureMaxC": st_frost["temperatureMaxC"],
        "requestedAt": now_iso,
        "deliveryDeadline": deadline_iso,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(pre_res.status_code == 200, "Ingested presealed Frost sample", pre_res)
    pre_sample_id = pre_res.json()["data"]["sampleId"]
    pre_journey_id = pre_res.json()["data"]["journeyId"]

    # 11. Search audit trail
    audit_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/search-audit-trail", headers=headers, json={
        "entityId": sample_id,
        "limit": 50
    })
    check(audit_res.status_code == 200, "Search audit trail", audit_res)
    audit_entries = audit_res.json()["data"].get("entries", [])
    check(len(audit_entries) >= 3, "Audit entries present for sample")

    # 12. Read operations state
    ops_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/read-operations-state", headers=headers, json={})
    check(ops_res.status_code == 200, "Read operations state", ops_res)
    ops_data = ops_res.json()["data"]
    check("samples" in ops_data and "workers" in ops_data and "locations" in ops_data, "Operations state structure valid")

    print("\n========================================================")
    print("ALL API ENDPOINTS & WORKFLOWS VALIDATED AND PASSED 100%!")
    print("========================================================\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        err_detail = f" (response: {resp.status_code} {resp.text})" if resp is not None else ""
        print(f"FAILED: {msg}{err_detail}")
        sys.exit(1)
    print(f"PASSED: {msg}")

import json
import requests
import sys
import time
import uuid

BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8080/api"

def check(condition, msg, resp=None):
    if not condition:
        err_detail = f" (response: {resp.status_code} {resp.text})" if resp is not None else ""
        print(f"FAILED: {msg}{err_detail}")
        sys.exit(1)
    print(f"PASSED: {msg}")

def main():
    session = requests.Session()

    res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": "admin",
        "password": "adminpass"
    })
    check(res.status_code == 200, "Admin login succeeded", res)
    admin_data = res.json()["data"]

        "roles": ["collection_professional"],

    earliest_iso = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now_ts + 600))
    latest_iso = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now_ts + 3600))

    dry_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/check-serviceability", headers=headers, json={
        "origin": {
            "latitude": 12.9784,
            "longitude": 77.6408,
            "address": "100 Feet Rd, Indiranagar"
        },
        "originType": "home",
        "sampleTypeId": st_amber_id,
        "requestedAt": now_iso,
        "earliestCollectionAt": earliest_iso,
        "latestCollectionAt": latest_iso,
        "deliveryDeadline": deadline_iso
    })
    check(dry_res.status_code == 200, "Serviceability check near Indiranagar", dry_res)

    check(dry_data.get("serviceable") is True, "Indiranagar is serviceable")
    check("snapshotVersion" in dry_data, "Serviceability includes snapshotVersion")

    # Unserviceable location (> 5km from any node)
    far_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/check-serviceability", headers=headers, json={

            "latitude": 13.5000,
            "longitude": 78.5000,
            "address": "Far Remote Location"
        },
        "originType": "home",
        "sampleTypeId": st_amber_id,
        "requestedAt": now_iso,
        "earliestCollectionAt": earliest_iso,
        "latestCollectionAt": latest_iso,
        "deliveryDeadline": deadline_iso
    })
    check(far_res.status_code == 200, "Serviceability check far away", far_res)
    check(far_res.json()["data"].get("serviceable") is False, "Far location is NOT serviceable")

    # 6. Requester logs in and creates collection request
    req_auth = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": "requester_eve",
        "password": "password123"

    check(req_auth.status_code == 200, "Requester authenticated", req_auth)
    req_token = req_auth.json()["data"]["sessionToken"]

    create_req = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-collection-request", headers=req_headers, json={

            "longitude": 77.6408,
            "address": "100 Feet Rd, Indiranagar"
        },
        "originType": "home",

        "earliestCollectionAt": earliest_iso,
        "latestCollectionAt": latest_iso,

    # Collector records location update

    # Collector collects and seals sample
    seal_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/collect-and-seal-sample", headers=col_headers, json={

    check(cou_work.status_code == 200, "Courier list role work", cou_work)
    cou_items = cou_work.json()["data"].get("workItems", [])
    check(len(cou_items) > 0, "Courier has work items")
    cou_assignment = cou_items[0]
    cou_assignment_id = cou_assignment["assignmentId"]

    # Courier accepts assignment
    session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/accept-assignment", headers=cou_headers, json={
        "assignmentId": cou_assignment_id,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })

    # Collector initiates handoff
    init_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/initiate-handoff", headers=col_headers, json={
        "sampleId": sample_id,
        "fromAssignmentId": col_assignment_id,
        "toAssignmentId": cou_assignment_id,
        "receiverId": courier_user_id,
        "initiatedAt": now_iso,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(init_res.status_code == 200, "Collector initiated handoff", init_res)
    handoff_id = init_res.json()["data"]["handoffId"]

    # Courier confirms handoff (receiver side)
    conf_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/confirm-handoff", headers=cou_headers, json={
        "handoffId": handoff_id,
        "confirmationSide": "receiver",
        "confirmedAt": now_iso,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(conf_res.status_code == 200, "Courier confirmed handoff (receiver)", conf_res)

    # Check sample state - holder should now be courier
    sample_state = session.get(f"{BASE_URL}/read-sample-state/{sample_id}", headers=headers)
    check(sample_state.status_code == 200, "Read sample state", sample_state)
    sample_data = sample_state.json()["data"]
    check(sample_data.get("currentHolderId") == courier_user_id, "Courier is now the current holder")

    # 9. Lab Operator confirms receipt
    lab_auth = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": "operator_david",
        "password": "password123"
    })
    check(lab_auth.status_code == 200, "Lab operator authenticated", lab_auth)
    lab_token = lab_auth.json()["data"]["sessionToken"]
    lab_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {lab_token}"}

    recv_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/confirm-laboratory-receipt", headers=lab_headers, json={
        "sampleId": sample_id,
        "laboratoryId": lab_node["id"],
        "receivedAt": now_iso,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(recv_res.status_code == 200, "Lab operator confirmed receipt", recv_res)

    # Check sample lifecycle
    life_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/read-sample-lifecycle", headers=headers, json={
        "sampleId": sample_id
    })
    check(life_res.status_code == 200, "Read sample lifecycle", life_res)
    events = life_res.json()["data"].get("events", [])
    check(len(events) >= 3, "Lifecycle contains multiple status events")

    # 10. Ingest presealed sample at node
    nh_auth = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": "handler_charlie",
        "password": "password123"
    })
    check(nh_auth.status_code == 200, "Node handler authenticated", nh_auth)
    nh_token = nh_auth.json()["data"]["sessionToken"]
    nh_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {nh_token}"}

    pre_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/ingest-presealed-sample", headers=nh_headers, json={
        "origin": {
            "latitude": hub_node["coordinate"]["latitude"],
            "longitude": hub_node["coordinate"]["longitude"],
            "address": "Central Bangalore Hub"
        },
        "originType": "node",
        "originNodeId": hub_node["id"],
        "sampleTypeId": st_frost_id,
        "containerType": "cooled_insulated",
        "temperatureMinC": 2.0,
        "temperatureMaxC": 8.0,
        "requestedAt": now_iso,
        "deliveryDeadline": deadline_iso,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(pre_res.status_code == 200, "Ingested presealed Frost sample", pre_res)
    pre_sample_id = pre_res.json()["data"]["sampleId"]
    pre_journey_id = pre_res.json()["data"]["journeyId"]

    # 11. Search audit trail
    audit_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/search-audit-trail", headers=headers, json={
        "entityId": sample_id,
        "limit": 50
    })
    check(audit_res.status_code == 200, "Search audit trail", audit_res)
    audit_entries = audit_res.json()["data"].get("entries", [])
    check(len(audit_entries) >= 3, "Audit entries present for sample")

    # 12. Read operations state
    ops_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/read-operations-state", headers=headers, json={})
    check(ops_res.status_code == 200, "Read operations state", ops_res)
    ops_data = ops_res.json()["data"]
    check("samples" in ops_data and "workers" in ops_data and "locations" in ops_data, "Operations state structure valid")

    print("\n========================================================")
    print("ALL API ENDPOINTS & WORKFLOWS VALIDATED AND PASSED 100%!")
    print("========================================================\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import json
import requests
import sys
import time
import uuid

BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8080/api"

def check(condition, msg, resp=None):
    if not condition:
        err_detail = f" (response: {resp.status_code} {resp.text})" if resp is not None else ""
        print(f"FAILED: {msg}{err_detail}")
        sys.exit(1)
    print(f"PASSED: {msg}")

def main():
    session = requests.Session()

    # 1. Admin login
    res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": "admin",
        "password": "adminpass"
    })
    check(res.status_code == 200, "Admin login succeeded", res)
    admin_data = res.json()["data"]
    token = admin_data.get("sessionToken")
    admin_user_id = admin_data.get("userId")
    check(token is not None and admin_user_id is not None, "Token and admin user ID returned")
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}

    # 2. Check ready endpoint
    ready_res = requests.get("http://127.0.0.1:8080/ready")
    check(ready_res.status_code == 200 and ready_res.json().get("status") == "ready", "Readiness check", ready_res)

    # 3. Bootstrap UI data
    boot_res = session.get(f"{BASE_URL}/ui/bootstrap", headers=headers)
    check(boot_res.status_code == 200, "Fetch UI bootstrap", boot_res)
    boot_data = boot_res.json()["data"]
    check("user" in boot_data and "operations" in boot_data, "UI bootstrap data structure valid")

    ops_data = boot_data["operations"]
    locations = ops_data.get("locations", [])
    loc_map = {loc["name"]: loc for loc in locations}
    check("Indiranagar Collection Centre" in loc_map, "Indiranagar CC found")
    check("Bangalore Central Hub & Laboratory" in loc_map, "Central Bangalore Hub found")
    check("Whitefield Regional Lab" in loc_map, "Whitefield Laboratory found")

    st_amber_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111101"
    st_frost_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111103"
    hub_node = loc_map["Bangalore Central Hub & Laboratory"]
    lab_node = loc_map["Whitefield Regional Lab"]
    cc_node = loc_map["Indiranagar Collection Centre"]

    # 4. Create users with different roles
    # Collector
    col_req = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": "collector_alice",
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Alice Collector",
        "email": "alice@example.com",
        "roles": ["collection_professional"],
        "certifications": [
            {"code": "Amber", "active": True},
            {"code": "Indigo", "active": True},
            {"code": "Frost", "active": True},
            {"code": "Pulse", "active": True}
        ],
        "qualifications": ["Amber", "Indigo", "Frost", "Pulse"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(col_req.status_code in [200, 201], "Created collector user", col_req)
    collector_user_id = col_req.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # Courier
    cou_req = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": "courier_bob",
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Bob Courier",
        "email": "bob@example.com",
        "roles": ["delivery_partner"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(cou_req.status_code in [200, 201], "Created courier user", cou_req)
    courier_user_id = cou_req.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # Node Handler
    nh_req = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": "handler_charlie",
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Charlie Handler",
        "email": "charlie@example.com",
        "roles": ["node_handler"],
        "assignedLocationId": hub_node["id"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(nh_req.status_code in [200, 201], "Created node handler user", nh_req)
    handler_user_id = nh_req.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # Lab Operator
    lab_req = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": "operator_david",
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "David LabOp",
        "email": "david@example.com",
        "roles": ["laboratory_team"],
        "assignedLocationId": lab_node["id"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(lab_req.status_code in [200, 201], "Created lab operator user", lab_req)
    operator_user_id = lab_req.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # Requester
    req_user_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": "requester_eve",
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Eve Requester",
        "email": "eve@example.com",
        "roles": ["requester"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(req_user_res.status_code in [200, 201], "Created requester user", req_user_res)
    requester_user_id = req_user_res.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # Dispatcher
    disp_user_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": "dispatcher_frank",
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Frank Dispatcher",
        "email": "frank@example.com",
        "roles": ["dispatcher"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(disp_user_res.status_code in [200, 201], "Created dispatcher user", disp_user_res)
    dispatcher_user_id = disp_user_res.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # 5. Serviceability check (dry run)
    now_ts = int(time.time())
    now_iso = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now_ts))
    deadline_iso = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now_ts + 18000))
    earliest_iso = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now_ts + 600))
    latest_iso = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now_ts + 3600))

    dry_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/check-serviceability", headers=headers, json={
        "origin": {
            "latitude": 12.9784,
            "longitude": 77.6408,
            "address": "100 Feet Rd, Indiranagar"
        },
        "originType": "home",
        "sampleTypeId": st_amber_id,
        "requestedAt": now_iso,
        "earliestCollectionAt": earliest_iso,
        "latestCollectionAt": latest_iso,
        "deliveryDeadline": deadline_iso
    })
    check(dry_res.status_code == 200, "Serviceability check near Indiranagar", dry_res)
    dry_data = dry_res.json()["data"]
    check(dry_data.get("serviceable") is True, "Indiranagar is serviceable")
    check("snapshotVersion" in dry_data, "Serviceability includes snapshotVersion")

    # Unserviceable location (> 5km from any node)
    far_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/check-serviceability", headers=headers, json={
        "origin": {
            "latitude": 13.5000,
            "longitude": 78.5000,
            "address": "Far Remote Location"
        },
        "originType": "home",
        "sampleTypeId": st_amber_id,
        "requestedAt": now_iso,
        "earliestCollectionAt": earliest_iso,
        "latestCollectionAt": latest_iso,
        "deliveryDeadline": deadline_iso
    })
    check(far_res.status_code == 200, "Serviceability check far away", far_res)
    check(far_res.json()["data"].get("serviceable") is False, "Far location is NOT serviceable")

    # 6. Requester logs in and creates collection request
    req_auth = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": "requester_eve",
        "password": "password123"
    })
    check(req_auth.status_code == 200, "Requester authenticated", req_auth)
    req_token = req_auth.json()["data"]["sessionToken"]
    req_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {req_token}"}

    create_req = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-collection-request", headers=req_headers, json={
        "requesterId": requester_user_id,
        "origin": {
            "latitude": 12.9784,
            "longitude": 77.6408,
            "address": "100 Feet Rd, Indiranagar"
        },
        "originType": "home",
        "requestedAt": now_iso,
        "earliestCollectionAt": earliest_iso,
        "latestCollectionAt": latest_iso,
        "deliveryDeadline": deadline_iso,
        "sampleTypeId": st_amber_id,
        "containerType": "standard_ambient",
        "temperatureMinC": 15.0,
        "temperatureMaxC": 25.0,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(create_req.status_code == 200, "Collection request created", create_req)
    req_resp = create_req.json()["data"]
    sample_id = req_resp.get("sampleId")
    journey_id = req_resp.get("journeyId")
    check(sample_id is not None and journey_id is not None, "Sample ID and Journey ID created")

    # Requester lists role work
    req_work = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/list-role-work", headers=req_headers, json={
        "role": "requester"
    })
    check(req_work.status_code == 200, "Requester list role work", req_work)
    req_items = req_work.json()["data"].get("workItems", [])
    check(any(item.get("sampleId") == sample_id for item in req_items), "Requester sees created request in role work")

    # 7. Collector logs in, views offered work, and accepts
    col_auth = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": "collector_alice",

        "handoffId": handoff_id,

    check(conf_res.status_code == 200, "Courier confirmed handoff (receiver)", conf_res)

    check(sample_state.status_code == 200, "Read sample state", sample_state)

    check(sample_data.get("currentHolderId") == courier_user_id, "Courier is now the current holder")

    check(recv_res.status_code == 200, "Lab operator confirmed receipt", recv_res)

import json
import requests
import sys
import time
import uuid

BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8080/api"

def check(condition, msg, resp=None):
    if not condition:
        err_detail = f" (response: {resp.status_code} {resp.text})" if resp is not None else ""
        print(f"FAILED: {msg}{err_detail}")
        sys.exit(1)
    print(f"PASSED: {msg}")

def main():
    session = requests.Session()

    # 1. Admin login
    res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": "admin",
        "password": "adminpass"
    })
    check(res.status_code == 200, "Admin login succeeded", res)
    admin_data = res.json()["data"]
    token = admin_data.get("sessionToken")
    admin_user_id = admin_data.get("userId")
    check(token is not None and admin_user_id is not None, "Token and admin user ID returned")
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}

    # 2. Check ready endpoint
    ready_res = requests.get("http://127.0.0.1:8080/ready")
    check(ready_res.status_code == 200 and ready_res.json().get("status") == "ready", "Readiness check", ready_res)

    # 3. Bootstrap UI data
    boot_res = session.get(f"{BASE_URL}/ui/bootstrap", headers=headers)
    check(boot_res.status_code == 200, "Fetch UI bootstrap", boot_res)
    boot_data = boot_res.json()["data"]
    check("user" in boot_data and "operations" in boot_data, "UI bootstrap data structure valid")

    ops_data = boot_data["operations"]
    locations = ops_data.get("locations", [])
    loc_map = {loc["name"]: loc for loc in locations}
    check("Indiranagar Collection Centre" in loc_map, "Indiranagar CC found")
    check("Bangalore Central Hub & Laboratory" in loc_map, "Central Bangalore Hub found")
    check("Whitefield Regional Lab" in loc_map, "Whitefield Laboratory found")

    st_amber_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111101"
    st_frost_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111103"
    hub_node = loc_map["Bangalore Central Hub & Laboratory"]
    lab_node = loc_map["Whitefield Regional Lab"]
    cc_node = loc_map["Indiranagar Collection Centre"]

    uid_suffix = uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]
    col_uname = f"col_{uid_suffix}"
    cou_uname = f"cou_{uid_suffix}"
    nh_uname = f"nh_{uid_suffix}"
    lab_uname = f"lab_{uid_suffix}"
    req_uname = f"req_{uid_suffix}"
    disp_uname = f"disp_{uid_suffix}"

    # 4. Create users with different roles
    # Collector
    col_req = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": col_uname,
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Alice Collector",
        "email": f"{col_uname}@example.com",
        "roles": ["collection_professional"],
        "certifications": [
            {"code": "Amber", "active": True},
            {"code": "Indigo", "active": True},
            {"code": "Frost", "active": True},
            {"code": "Pulse", "active": True}
        ],
        "qualifications": ["Amber", "Indigo", "Frost", "Pulse"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(col_req.status_code in [200, 201], "Created collector user", col_req)
    collector_user_id = col_req.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # Courier
    cou_req = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": cou_uname,
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Bob Courier",
        "email": f"{cou_uname}@example.com",
        "roles": ["delivery_partner"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(cou_req.status_code in [200, 201], "Created courier user", cou_req)
    courier_user_id = cou_req.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # Node Handler
    nh_req = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": nh_uname,
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Charlie Handler",
        "email": f"{nh_uname}@example.com",
        "roles": ["node_handler"],
        "assignedLocationId": hub_node["id"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(nh_req.status_code in [200, 201], "Created node handler user", nh_req)
    handler_user_id = nh_req.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # Lab Operator
    lab_req = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": lab_uname,
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "David LabOp",
        "email": f"{lab_uname}@example.com",
        "roles": ["laboratory_team"],
        "assignedLocationId": lab_node["id"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(lab_req.status_code in [200, 201], "Created lab operator user", lab_req)
    operator_user_id = lab_req.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # Requester
    req_user_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": req_uname,
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Eve Requester",
        "email": f"{req_uname}@example.com",
        "roles": ["requester"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(req_user_res.status_code in [200, 201], "Created requester user", req_user_res)
    requester_user_id = req_user_res.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # Dispatcher
    disp_user_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": disp_uname,
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Frank Dispatcher",
        "email": f"{disp_uname}@example.com",
        "roles": ["dispatcher"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(disp_user_res.status_code in [200, 201], "Created dispatcher user", disp_user_res)
    dispatcher_user_id = disp_user_res.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # 5. Serviceability check (dry run)
    now_ts = int(time.time())
    now_iso = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now_ts))
    deadline_iso = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now_ts + 18000))
    earliest_iso = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now_ts + 600))
    latest_iso = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now_ts + 3600))

    dry_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/check-serviceability", headers=headers, json={
        "origin": {
            "latitude": 12.9784,
            "longitude": 77.6408,
            "address": "100 Feet Rd, Indiranagar"
        },
        "originType": "home",
        "sampleTypeId": st_amber_id,
        "requestedAt": now_iso,
        "earliestCollectionAt": earliest_iso,
        "latestCollectionAt": latest_iso,
        "deliveryDeadline": deadline_iso
    })
    check(dry_res.status_code == 200, "Serviceability check near Indiranagar", dry_res)
    dry_data = dry_res.json()["data"]
    check(dry_data.get("serviceable") is True, "Indiranagar is serviceable")
    check("serviceabilityVersion" in dry_data, "Serviceability includes serviceabilityVersion")

    # Unserviceable location (> 5km from any node)
    far_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/check-serviceability", headers=headers, json={
        "origin": {
            "latitude": 13.5000,
            "longitude": 78.5000,
            "address": "Far Remote Location"
        },
        "originType": "home",
        "sampleTypeId": st_amber_id,
        "requestedAt": now_iso,
        "earliestCollectionAt": earliest_iso,
        "latestCollectionAt": latest_iso,
        "deliveryDeadline": deadline_iso
    })
    check(far_res.status_code == 200, "Serviceability check far away", far_res)
    check(far_res.json()["data"].get("serviceable") is False, "Far location is NOT serviceable")

    # 6. Requester logs in and creates collection request
    req_auth = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": "requester_eve",
        "password": "password123"
    })
    check(req_auth.status_code == 200, "Requester authenticated", req_auth)
    req_token = req_auth.json()["data"]["sessionToken"]

import json
import requests
import sys
import time
import uuid

BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8080/api"

def check(condition, msg, resp=None):
    if not condition:
        err_detail = f" (response: {resp.status_code} {resp.text})" if resp is not None else ""
        print(f"FAILED: {msg}{err_detail}")
        sys.exit(1)
    print(f"PASSED: {msg}")

def main():
    session = requests.Session()

    # 1. Admin login
    res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": "admin",
        "password": "adminpass"
    })
    check(res.status_code == 200, "Admin login succeeded", res)
    admin_data = res.json()["data"]
    token = admin_data.get("sessionToken")
    admin_user_id = admin_data.get("userId")
    check(token is not None and admin_user_id is not None, "Token and admin user ID returned")
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}

    # 2. Check ready endpoint
    ready_res = requests.get("http://127.0.0.1:8080/ready")
    check(ready_res.status_code == 200 and ready_res.json().get("status") == "ready", "Readiness check", ready_res)

    # 3. Bootstrap UI data
    boot_res = session.get(f"{BASE_URL}/ui/bootstrap", headers=headers)
    check(boot_res.status_code == 200, "Fetch UI bootstrap", boot_res)
    boot_data = boot_res.json()["data"]
    check("user" in boot_data and "operations" in boot_data, "UI bootstrap data structure valid")

    ops_data = boot_data["operations"]
    locations = ops_data.get("locations", [])
    loc_map = {loc["name"]: loc for loc in locations}
    check("Indiranagar Collection Centre" in loc_map, "Indiranagar CC found")
    check("Bangalore Central Hub & Laboratory" in loc_map, "Central Bangalore Hub found")
    check("Whitefield Regional Lab" in loc_map, "Whitefield Laboratory found")

    st_amber_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111101"
    st_frost_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111103"
    hub_node = loc_map["Bangalore Central Hub & Laboratory"]
    lab_node = loc_map["Whitefield Regional Lab"]
    cc_node = loc_map["Indiranagar Collection Centre"]

    uid_suffix = uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]
    col_uname = f"col_{uid_suffix}"
    cou_uname = f"cou_{uid_suffix}"
    nh_uname = f"nh_{uid_suffix}"
    lab_uname = f"lab_{uid_suffix}"
    req_uname = f"req_{uid_suffix}"
    disp_uname = f"disp_{uid_suffix}"

    # 4. Create users with different roles
    # Collector
    col_req = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": col_uname,
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Alice Collector",
        "email": f"{col_uname}@example.com",
        "roles": ["collection_professional"],
        "certifications": [
            {"code": "Amber", "active": True},
            {"code": "Indigo", "active": True},
            {"code": "Frost", "active": True},
            {"code": "Pulse", "active": True}
        ],
        "qualifications": ["Amber", "Indigo", "Frost", "Pulse"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(col_req.status_code in [200, 201], "Created collector user", col_req)
    collector_user_id = col_req.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # Courier
    cou_req = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": cou_uname,
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Bob Courier",
        "email": f"{cou_uname}@example.com",
        "roles": ["delivery_partner"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(cou_req.status_code in [200, 201], "Created courier user", cou_req)
    courier_user_id = cou_req.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # Node Handler
    nh_req = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": nh_uname,
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Charlie Handler",
        "email": f"{nh_uname}@example.com",
        "roles": ["node_handler"],
        "assignedLocationId": hub_node["id"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(nh_req.status_code in [200, 201], "Created node handler user", nh_req)
    handler_user_id = nh_req.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # Lab Operator
    lab_req = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": lab_uname,
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "David LabOp",
        "email": f"{lab_uname}@example.com",
        "roles": ["laboratory_team"],
        "assignedLocationId": lab_node["id"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(lab_req.status_code in [200, 201], "Created lab operator user", lab_req)
    operator_user_id = lab_req.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # Requester
    req_user_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": req_uname,
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Eve Requester",
        "email": f"{req_uname}@example.com",
        "roles": ["requester"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(req_user_res.status_code in [200, 201], "Created requester user", req_user_res)
    requester_user_id = req_user_res.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # Dispatcher
    disp_user_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": disp_uname,
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Frank Dispatcher",
        "email": f"{disp_uname}@example.com",
        "roles": ["dispatcher"],
        "active": True
    })
    check(disp_user_res.status_code in [200, 201], "Created dispatcher user", disp_user_res)
    dispatcher_user_id = disp_user_res.json()["data"]["userId"]

    # 5. Serviceability check (dry run)
    now_ts = int(time.time())
    now_iso = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now_ts))
    deadline_iso = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now_ts + 18000))
    earliest_iso = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now_ts + 600))
    latest_iso = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(now_ts + 3600))

    dry_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/check-serviceability", headers=headers, json={
        "origin": {
            "latitude": 12.9784,
            "longitude": 77.6408,
            "address": "100 Feet Rd, Indiranagar"
        },
        "originType": "home",
        "sampleTypeId": st_amber_id,
        "requestedAt": now_iso,
        "earliestCollectionAt": earliest_iso,
        "latestCollectionAt": latest_iso,
        "deliveryDeadline": deadline_iso
    })
    check(dry_res.status_code == 200, "Serviceability check near Indiranagar", dry_res)
    dry_data = dry_res.json()["data"]
    check(dry_data.get("serviceable") is True, "Indiranagar is serviceable")
    check("serviceabilityVersion" in dry_data, "Serviceability includes serviceabilityVersion")

    # Unserviceable location (> 5km from any node)
    far_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/check-serviceability", headers=headers, json={
        "origin": {
            "latitude": 13.5000,
            "longitude": 78.5000,
            "address": "Far Remote Location"
        },
        "originType": "home",
        "sampleTypeId": st_amber_id,
        "requestedAt": now_iso,
        "earliestCollectionAt": earliest_iso,
        "latestCollectionAt": latest_iso,
        "deliveryDeadline": deadline_iso
    })
    check(far_res.status_code == 200, "Serviceability check far away", far_res)
    check(far_res.json()["data"].get("serviceable") is False, "Far location is NOT serviceable")

    # 6. Requester logs in and creates collection request
    req_auth = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": req_uname,
        "password": "password123"
    })
    check(req_auth.status_code == 200, "Requester authenticated", req_auth)
    req_token = req_auth.json()["data"]["sessionToken"]
    req_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {req_token}"}

    create_req = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-collection-request", headers=req_headers, json={
        "requesterId": requester_user_id,
        "origin": {
            "latitude": 12.9784,
            "longitude": 77.6408,
            "address": "100 Feet Rd, Indiranagar"
        },
        "originType": "home",
        "requestedAt": now_iso,
        "earliestCollectionAt": earliest_iso,
        "latestCollectionAt": latest_iso,
        "deliveryDeadline": deadline_iso,
        "sampleTypeId": st_amber_id,
        "containerType": "standard_ambient",
        "temperatureMinC": 15.0,
        "temperatureMaxC": 25.0,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(create_req.status_code == 200, "Collection request created", create_req)
    req_resp = create_req.json()["data"]
    sample_id = req_resp.get("sampleId")
    journey_id = req_resp.get("journeyId")
    check(sample_id is not None and journey_id is not None, "Sample ID and Journey ID created")

    # Requester lists role work
    req_work = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/list-role-work", headers=req_headers, json={
        "role": "requester"
    })
    check(req_work.status_code == 200, "Requester list role work", req_work)
    req_items = req_work.json()["data"].get("workItems", [])
    check(any(item.get("sampleId") == sample_id for item in req_items), "Requester sees created request in role work")

    # 7. Collector logs in, views offered work, and accepts
    col_auth = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": col_uname,
        "password": "password123"
    })
    check(col_auth.status_code == 200, "Collector authenticated", col_auth)
    col_token = col_auth.json()["data"]["sessionToken"]
    col_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {col_token}"}

    col_work = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/list-role-work", headers=col_headers, json={
        "role": "collection_professional"
    })
    check(col_work.status_code == 200, "Collector list role work", col_work)
    col_items = col_work.json()["data"].get("workItems", [])
    check(len(col_items) > 0, "Collector has offered work items")
    col_assignment = col_items[0]
    col_assignment_id = col_assignment["assignmentId"]

    # Collector accepts assignment
    acc_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/accept-assignment", headers=col_headers, json={
        "assignmentId": col_assignment_id,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(acc_res.status_code == 200, "Collector accepted assignment", acc_res)

    # Collector records location update
    loc_upd = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/record-worker-location", headers=col_headers, json={
        "assignmentId": col_assignment_id,
        "coordinate": {"latitude": 12.9780, "longitude": 77.6400},
        "sequence": 1,
        "recordedAt": now_iso
    })
    check(loc_upd.status_code == 200, "Collector recorded location", loc_upd)

    # Collector collects and seals sample
    seal_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/collect-and-seal-sample", headers=col_headers, json={
        "sampleId": sample_id,
        "assignmentId": col_assignment_id,
        "collectedAt": now_iso,
        "containerType": "standard_ambient",
        "observedTemperatureC": 22.0,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(seal_res.status_code == 200, "Sample collected and sealed", seal_res)

    # Collector records handling checkpoint
    chk_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/record-handling-checkpoint", headers=col_headers, json={
        "sampleId": sample_id,
        "assignmentId": col_assignment_id,
        "containerType": "standard_ambient",
        "observedTemperatureC": 21.5,
        "recordedAt": now_iso,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(chk_res.status_code == 200, "Handling checkpoint recorded", chk_res)

    # 8. Handoff to Courier
    # Courier logs in
    cou_auth = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": cou_uname,
        "password": "password123"
    })
    check(cou_auth.status_code == 200, "Courier authenticated", cou_auth)
    cou_token = cou_auth.json()["data"]["sessionToken"]
    cou_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {cou_token}"}

    cou_work = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/list-role-work", headers=cou_headers, json={
        "role": "delivery_partner"
    })
    check(cou_work.status_code == 200, "Courier list role work", cou_work)
    cou_items = cou_work.json()["data"].get("workItems", [])
    check(len(cou_items) > 0, "Courier has work items")
    cou_assignment = cou_items[0]
    cou_assignment_id = cou_assignment["assignmentId"]

    # Courier accepts assignment
    session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/accept-assignment", headers=cou_headers, json={
        "assignmentId": cou_assignment_id,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })

    # Collector initiates handoff
    init_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/initiate-handoff", headers=col_headers, json={
        "sampleId": sample_id,
        "fromAssignmentId": col_assignment_id,
        "toAssignmentId": cou_assignment_id,
        "receiverId": courier_user_id,
        "initiatedAt": now_iso,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(init_res.status_code == 200, "Collector initiated handoff", init_res)
    handoff_id = init_res.json()["data"]["handoffId"]

    # Courier confirms handoff (receiver side)
    conf_res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/confirm-handoff", headers=cou_headers, json={
        "handoffId": handoff_id,
        "confirmationSide": "receiver",
        "confirmedAt": now_iso,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    })
    check(conf_res.status_code == 200, "Courier confirmed handoff (receiver)", conf_res)

    # Check sample state - holder should now be courier
    sample_state = session.get(f"{BASE_URL}/read-sample-state/{sample_id}", headers=headers)
    check(sample_state.status_code == 200, "Read sample state", sample_state)
    sample_data = sample_state.json()["data"]
    check(sample_data.get("currentHolderId") == courier_user_id, "Courier is now the current holder")

    # 9. Lab Operator confirms receipt

import json
import requests
import sys
import time
import uuid

BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8080/api"

def check(condition, msg, resp=None):
    if not condition:
        err_detail = f" (response: {resp.status_code} {resp.text})" if resp is not None else ""
        print(f"FAILED: {msg}{err_detail}")
        sys.exit(1)
    print(f"PASSED: {msg}")

def main():
    session = requests.Session()

    # 1. Admin login
    res = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/authenticate-user", json={
        "username": "admin",
        "password": "adminpass"
    })
    check(res.status_code == 200, "Admin login succeeded", res)
    admin_data = res.json()["data"]
    token = admin_data.get("sessionToken")
    admin_user_id = admin_data.get("userId")
    check(token is not None and admin_user_id is not None, "Token and admin user ID returned")
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}

    # 2. Check ready endpoint
    ready_res = requests.get("http://127.0.0.1:8080/ready")
    check(ready_res.status_code == 200 and ready_res.json().get("status") == "ready", "Readiness check", ready_res)

    # 3. Bootstrap UI data
    boot_res = session.get(f"{BASE_URL}/ui/bootstrap", headers=headers)
    check(boot_res.status_code == 200, "Fetch UI bootstrap", boot_res)
    boot_data = boot_res.json()["data"]
    check("user" in boot_data and "operations" in boot_data, "UI bootstrap data structure valid")

    ops_data = boot_data["operations"]
    locations = ops_data.get("locations", [])
    loc_map = {loc["name"]: loc for loc in locations}
    check("Indiranagar Collection Centre" in loc_map, "Indiranagar CC found")
    check("Bangalore Central Hub & Laboratory" in loc_map, "Central Bangalore Hub found")
    check("Whitefield Regional Lab" in loc_map, "Whitefield Laboratory found")

    st_amber_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111101"
    st_frost_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111103"

    lab_node = loc_map["Whitefield Regional Lab"]
    cc_node = loc_map["Indiranagar Collection Centre"]

    uid_suffix = uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]
    col_uname = f"col_{uid_suffix}"
    cou_uname = f"cou_{uid_suffix}"
    nh_uname = f"nh_{uid_suffix}"
    lab_uname = f"lab_{uid_suffix}"
    req_uname = f"req_{uid_suffix}"
    disp_uname = f"disp_{uid_suffix}"

    # 4. Create users with different roles
    # Collector
    col_req = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/create-user", headers=headers, json={
        "username": col_uname,
        "initialPassword": "password123",
        "fullName": "Alice Collector",
        "email": f"{col_uname}@example.com",
        "roles": ["collection_professional"],
        "certifications": [
            {"code": "Amber", "active": True},
            {"code": "Indigo", "active": True},
            {"code": "Frost", "active": True},
